title: A $9 Billion Company Built on a Lie #shorts
description:
At 19, she dropped out of Stanford to build a machine that could run hundreds of tests from one drop of blood. Investors valued her company at $9 billion. The machine never worked.
The rise and fall of Theranos.
Follow for more true stories of fortunes made and lost.
hook_text:
$9 BILLION COMPANY
BUILT ON A LIE
first_comment: How did so many smart, rich investors never ask to see the machine work? 👇

lines.text: At nineteen, she dropped out of Stanford with a promise.
Hundreds of medical tests, from just one drop of blood.
Famous investors and powerful board members lined up behind her.
By 2014, Theranos was valued at nine billion dollars.
There was just one problem. The machine didn't work.
In secret, many tests were run on ordinary machines bought from other companies.
Real patients were getting results that could be wrong.
In 2015, a Wall Street Journal reporter exposed everything.
The value fell to zero, and in 2018 the company shut down.
Its founder, Elizabeth Holmes, was convicted of fraud and sentenced to more than eleven years in prison.
